install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
# Native installer refuses sudo-from-user without this; container installs often run as root.
export CLAUDE_INSTALL_ALLOW_SUDO="${CLAUDE_INSTALL_ALLOW_SUDO:-1}"

echo "==> Installing Claude AI CLI (Claude Code)"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl bash
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Sy --noconfirm ca-certificates curl bash
fi

curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash

# Ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH for login and interactive shells.
PROFILE_SNIPPET='
# Claude Code (claude-ai-cli)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
'
for profile in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" /etc/profile.d/claude-ai-cli.sh; do
  dir="$(dirname "$profile")"
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  if [ ! -f "$profile" ] || ! grep -q 'Claude Code (claude-ai-cli)' "$profile" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' "$PROFILE_SNIPPET" >> "$profile"
  fi
done

if ! command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" /usr/local/bin/claude
  fi
fi

echo "==> Verifying installation"
claude --version
echo "==> Claude AI CLI installed at $(command -v claude)"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"

echo "==> Removing Claude AI CLI (Claude Code)"
rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" /usr/local/bin/claude
rm -rf "$HOME/.claude/downloads"
for f in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" /etc/profile.d/claude-ai-cli.sh; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  if [ "$f" = /etc/profile.d/claude-ai-cli.sh ]; then
    rm -f "$f"
    continue
  fi
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  awk '
    /Claude Code \(claude-ai-cli\)/ { skip=1; next }
    skip && /^export PATH=.*\.local\/bin/ { skip=0; next }
    { skip=0; print }
  ' "$f" > "$tmp" || true
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
done
echo "==> Claude AI CLI removed (auth under ~/.claude left intact)"
upgrade_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
export CLAUDE_INSTALL_ALLOW_SUDO="${CLAUDE_INSTALL_ALLOW_SUDO:-1}"

echo "==> Upgrading Claude AI CLI (Claude Code)"
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- latest
claude --version
echo "==> Upgrade complete"
